text:
maria: FYI saw a nasty reconnect ripple in eu-west around 10:12 UTC. lots of clients hitting immediate reconnect loops after auth rotation.
kevin: is this specific to resume tokens or generic auth rotations?
maria: mostly resume flows. pattern: client connects, proxy returns 401 while fetching rotated key, client retries aggressively and we see a fanout of reconnects. logs: 
```
[10:12:11] GET /stream tenant=acme resume=abc123 -> 401
[10:12:11] proxy: fetching keyring (rotation) hold=872ms
[10:12:12] auth-svc validate resume=abc123 -> 200
[10:12:12] SSE open -> client EOF -> reconnect spam
```
raj: 872ms block on hot path is bad. can we avoid locking? maybe keep a standby token during rotation.
sara: short-term proposals: 1) make proxy return 503 + Retry-After when rotation-flag set so clients back off 2) recommend SDKs use randomized jitter backoffs (e.g., 300-900ms) for 401s 3) emit a metric keyring_refresh_block_ms and add to streaming dashboard.
kevin: returning 503 will change how reconnects are attributed in billing; we should also add a short dedupe window server-side to avoid double-billing when retries happen.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-400 created and assigned to kevin.
raj: i'll prototype a lightweight dedupe (3s window keyed by resume_id+client_ip) and a metric exporter for keyring blocking.
sara: I'll open a feature-flagged PR to return 503 with Retry-After=10s during rotation windows. set canary to 5% eu-west.
maria: console side: our dashboard currently shows sum(rate(sse_reconnect_total[5m])) by region only. can we add a tenant heatmap and auth_handoff_latency_ms timeseries so on-call can triage faster?
kevin: also UX idea: when deploys touch auth/keyring, annotate the timeline and auto-scan for auth_handoff_latency p95 spikes in the canary window. surface an alert card if correlated.
sara: we already record deploy events; building a post-deploy metric scan is doable. i'll add it to the runbook.
kevin: plan: (A) canary proxy change -> 5% eu-west, (B) SDK note + quick client-edge throttle, (C) metric exporter & dashboard tile, (D) dedupe patch. watch metrics: sse_reconnect_rate, auth_handoff_latency_ms, keyring_refresh_block_ms, and billing_delta.
maria: please update thread with canary graphs after rollout.
kevin: deploying canary at 10:30 UTC. will report back.
